_comment: Creative-engine enforcement rules for Batti-Performance. Mirrors the Athletes Acceleration / Castille ruleset (same youth-sports-performance creative contract) so a repurposed campaign validates under Batti identically to its source. Consumed by scripts/validate-plan.mjs via loadRules(); without this file the brand falls back to DEFAULT_RULES, which is stricter (no mediaExempt) and false-flags motion stat-reveal/logo-sting cards. DEVIATION FROM AA: 'guaranteed' is intentionally NOT in bannedWords — Batti's brand voice explicitly uses 'We GUARANTEE' / '100% guaranteed results' as a core trope (the accountability promise IS the product), so banning it would false-flag the brand's own verbatim copy. eyebrowPattern stays '{CITY} SPORT PARENTS'; Batti cities are Orland Park / Manteno / Gilbert.
_beatRolesNote: anyOf = the beat's VALID role set; an asset must carry >=1.
